name: mcp-view
notes: Split-pane Servers | Tools | Detail. The opener must be `/mcp` with NO arguments: the arm opens the panel on a bare /mcp and RUNS THE CLI SUBCOMMAND with arguments (`operant mcp list|add|remove|test|serve|login|configure`), so `/mcp list` never opens this panel. (iter-1792) The note that used to sit here said the arm "explicitly returns false for `mcp` when args are non-empty" and called `/mcp r` "the documented reconnect form" — BOTH were false: the arm shells out and returns true, and `operant mcp` has no `r` subcommand (`operant mcp r` is an "unrecognized subcommand" error). The reconnect action is the panel's own `r` KEY, on the Servers pane. ENV: server and tool counts come from the live operant.toml.
